Title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for early-July 2025

Body.Content:
In early-July 2025, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Convert Azure SQL database to Hyperscale while keeping existing active geo-replication or failover group configurations. Learn more. 

  • Try the mssql-python driver with new platform support and powerful features for Microsoft SQL Server and the Azure SQL family. Learn more.  

  • Rapid prototyping in Visual Studio Code with local SQL containers, GitHub Copilot agent mode, and connection groups. Learn more.
